content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to use the [company_name] [product_name] app to toggle a value by pressing the same button repeatedly? I know how to set a new value when clicking a button, but can it be used for toggling? For example: first click sets the value to 1, second click sets it to 0, third click changes it back to 1, and so on. Is this supported?
Please refer to this topic: [version_no] push button

analysis.insight_summary: A user is asking if the [company_name] [product_name] app can support toggling a value between two states (1 and 0) using the same button, a feature commonly expected in control or HMI applications. Based on current design, setting values may be possible, but it is unclear if toggle behavior is natively supported.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the application to provide a native toggle function where pressing one button alternates a value between two states.
